name: olio.pictureBookCharacterStyle
description: Per-character style override for a picture book: styles ONLY this one character's pipeline-rendered portrait (matched by its charPerson objectId) with its own olio.sd.config, while the composite, landscape, and every other character keep the book's global sdConfig. This is the book-pipeline meta-embedded override (Stage 1 portrait generation). Since S5, setCharacterStyleOverride also syncs to 'sdcfg-<charObjectId>' in ~/Data/.preferences so the pipeline and the UI reimage workflow share one config store.

fields.name: characterObjectId
fields.description: objectId of the olio.charPerson this override styles.

fields.name: characterName
fields.description: Convenience label for UI/debug; matching is by characterObjectId, not name.

fields.name: sdConfig
fields.description: The style/config used for THIS character's portrait only. Its style clause (SDUtil.getSDConfigPrompt) replaces the book's global style for this portrait; other generation params fall back to the book common config.
